admin.operator-tasks.note: The operator tasks of Orazaka run against the real DB through the console API on dev: accounts (list, detail, suspend/restore, role, export, erase) with their audit; billing (plans, packs, pricebook, wallets) and Studio blueprints/bundles and the model registry, each write audited; settings as parameters with revision, who, when, why: app-config PUT then rollback proven live (android revision 1 -> 2 -> 3, requests devpreview-config-0005/-0006, both audited). The Tasks tab (Operations -> Tasks, orazaka-web-client#213) is the operator's queue, derived from the services' audit and the job queue (a refused/failed action with no later success, a failed job of the last day), tested first (src/console/test/tasks.test.mts). Not covered: moderation and consent-withdrawal queues (Orazaka has no moderation surface; the wellbeing erase of orazaka#301 is the user's own action) and a one-click retry of a failed job (no retry endpoint yet).

admin.audit-log.note: Every operator write leaves an audit line (actor, action, target, request id, ok|refused|failed, ids only) in each service that has an operator surface: identity (krizaka-users#45/#46: account suspend/restore/role/export/erase), billing (krizaka-billing#45: every ADMIN write), Studio (orazaka-studio#43: blueprints, pack bundles), engine (orazaka-conversation-service#45/#46: model registry, app config); the edge keeps/issues the X-Request-Id (orazaka-edge#33). Tests first in each repo (filters, outcome, identity IT). Console: Audit log over the four services, filter by service/outcome/who/action/request, CSV (orazaka-web-client#208/#209/#211/#212).
